intentComment: Story 051 — end-to-end StableStaker config verification (deploy, stake, evm_increaseTime 1 day, claim+withdraw, assert ~10 phUSD reward + principal/baseline restored). NOT a unit test: it is a config/smoke check where a clean no-revert run IS the verification.

default.note: Single variant. Broadcasts to a LOCAL Anvil (chain-id 31337) only — never mainnet. No :preview/:dry/:broadcast siblings exist. `set -e` aborts on first failure; a cleanup trap on EXIT tears down the spawned Anvil.

envVars.name: ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.source: repo-root /home/justin/code/audits/.envrc sets ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY=0xac0974...ff80 (Anvil default account #0). The shell ALSO hardcodes the same key as PRIVATE_KEY but does NOT export ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY itself — the forge scripts rely on it being present in the environment (direnv/.envrc). If ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY is unset, STEP 1 reverts in vm.envUint before any staking.

preconditions.note: The script spins up its OWN Anvil in the background (does not assume a pre-running node) and tears it down on exit. It does assume foundry + npm are installed and ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY is in the environment.

steps.intent: chdir into the submodule root (so relative paths like server/deployments/progress.31337.json and script/ resolve), fail-fast on any error, and register a cleanup trap that kills the spawned Anvil pid on exit.
Delete prior local deployment artifacts and broadcast caches so the run starts from a clean slate (no stale progress.31337.json addresses).

steps.command: anvil --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 > /tmp/anvil-stable-staker.log 2>&1 & ; ANVIL_PID=$! ; wait-loop: poll `cast block-number --rpc-url http://localhost:8545` up to 30x (1s sleep) until ready
steps.intent: Start a fresh local Anvil (chain-id 31337) in the background and block until its JSON-RPC answers block-number. ANVIL_PID is captured for the cleanup trap.

steps.expands: npm run clean:local && forge script script/DeployMocks.s.sol:DeployMocks --rpc-url http://localhost:8545 --broadcast --slow
steps.intent: Deploy and wire the full mock stack to Anvil, including (Phase 3.7, story 051) the StableStaker farm with 3 pools — DOLA & USDe at 10 phUSD/day, USDC at 5 phUSD/day — each pool's ERC4626YieldStrategy authorized two-sided (staker as client on strategy + strategy on staker), and StableStaker authorized as a phUSD minter. Writes all deployed addresses to server/deployments/progress.31337.json.
steps.note: deploy:local re-runs clean:local internally, so progress.31337.json is removed then rewritten by DeployMocks._writeProgressFile().

steps.intent: STEP 1 — Stake 1,000 DOLA into the StableStaker DOLA pool as the deployer. Reads StableStaker + MockDola addresses from progress.31337.json; asserts the DOLA pool rate == 10 ether/86400; approves + stake(); asserts userInfo.amount == 1000e18, totalStaked increased by 1000e18, deployer DOLA debited by 1000e18. Records the pre-stake totalStaked baseline implicitly (re-derived in STEP 3).

steps.command: cast rpc evm_increaseTime 86400 --rpc-url http://localhost:8545 ; cast rpc evm_mine --rpc-url http://localhost:8545
steps.intent: STEP 2 — Advance the LIVE Anvil clock by exactly one day (86400s) and mine a block so the new timestamp takes effect. Done out-of-band via cast rpc because vm.warp inside a --broadcast forge script does NOT move the live chain clock; reward accrual in StableStaker keys off block.timestamp, so this is the mechanism that makes ~10 phUSD/day accrue.

STEP 3 — Claim phUSD reward, withdraw the full 1,000 DOLA principal, and assert the three story-051 invariants: (a) reward credited within [9.9, 10.1] phUSD; (b) full principal returned to wallet (within <=10 wei ERC4626 rounding dust kept by the strategy); (c) pool totalStaked returns to the pre-stake baseline. All assertions are Solidity require() statements — a revert fails the whole shell run via set -e.

steps.command: echo PASSED ; (trap cleanup EXIT) -> kill $ANVIL_PID ; wait
steps.intent: Print the success banner and tear down the spawned Anvil. A clean run with no reverts is the verification.

assertionSummary.principal: userInfo.amount == 0 AND (STAKE_AMOUNT - returned) <= 10 wei AND returned <= STAKE_AMOUNT
